speeches.text: I think it’s crucial that we regroup after the tragic loss of the seer, Carol. I suggest the doctor consider protecting someone they trust, which could help us identify possible targets and build a strong alliance against the werewolves. If we can agree on who the doctor should protect, it will give us an advantage in uncovering their identities. Let's work together and stay vigilant!
